race.comment: SNUGG (8) was a dominant winner last time at Beaudesert over the same distance. Is going well this campaign, recording a win and a minor placing from four starts. High on confidence now and is sure to run well. TOSCANELLA (10) showed good early speed over 1300m at Toowoomba last time and went on to salute by a nose. Won't find this as tough and is sure to be competitive. LONERGY (3) lines up on the back of a 6-length fourth over 1400m at Warra as favourite. Has a sound record here with two wins from four starts and shapes as one of the genuine contenders. HELLO DOLLY DIVA (13) came from a wide gate and could only manage to finish seventh last time out over 1350m at Ipswich. Draws a better marble this time. In the mix.
